index.title: Free Email Optimisation Tools
index.description: Free email marketing tools by Jonathan Pay — analyse copy, check readability, test A/B results, and more.

hypothesis.title: A/B Test Hypothesis Builder
hypothesis.description: Turn a vague test idea into a hypothesis you can actually prove wrong. A guided set of questions, then hand it on to the Duration Calculator. No sign-up needed.

ab-duration.title: A/B Test Duration Calculator
ab-duration.description: Know how long to run your A/B test before you start. Calculate required sample size and test duration with a two-proportion z-test. No sign-up needed.

sscc.title: Statistical Significance Calculator
sscc.description: Check whether your email A/B test result is statistically significant before you act on it. Enter sample sizes and conversion rates — no sign-up needed.

wewe.title: We-We Calculator
wewe.description: Check if your email copy talks about you or to your reader. Count brand-focused vs. customer-focused pronouns instantly — no sign-up needed.

ers.title: Email Readability Score
ers.description: Score your email copy's readability with Flesch Reading Ease, Gunning Fog, and SMOG — with per-word syllable counting and actionable suggestions. No sign-up needed.

f2b.title: Feature-to-Benefit Converter
f2b.description: Turn product features into customer benefits. Pick your industry, enter a feature, and get a benefit statement from 384 templates across 8 verticals. No sign-up needed.

tone.title: Email Tone Analyser
tone.description: Detect the tone of your email copy across five dimensions — Friendly, Persuasive, Professional, Urgent, and Empathetic — with phrase suggestions for shifting tone. No sign-up needed.

persona.title: Buyer Persona Matcher
persona.description: Find out who your email copy is really speaking to. Detects Competitive, Spontaneous, Humanistic, and Methodical buyer modalities, with phrase suggestions — no sign-up needed.

emotional-appeal.title: Emotional Appeal Analyser
emotional-appeal.description: Detect the emotional triggers in your email copy — Fear, Hope, Curiosity, Pride, Trust, and Belonging — with guidance on when each appeal works best. No sign-up needed.

personalisation.title: Personalisation & Dynamic Content Checker
personalisation.description: Check your email's personalisation tokens and dynamic content blocks for missing fallbacks and unbalanced conditionals, across 16 ESP syntaxes. No sign-up needed.

accessibility.title: Email Accessibility Checker
accessibility.description: Check your email HTML against common accessibility pitfalls — missing alt text, vague link text, undersized fonts, poor colour contrast, and broken heading order. No sign-up needed.

curve.title: CURVE Subject Line Builder
curve.description: Score your subject line against HEA's CURVE framework — Curiosity, Urgency, Relevance, Value, Emotion — and see exactly which element is missing. No sign-up needed.

dmarc-checker.title: Free DMARC, SPF & DKIM Checker
